content:
Developers can now submit apps for iOS 27 and other new Apple operating systems, which are set to launch next Monday. Here's a detailed breakdown of the updates.

Developers can from today submit apps built specifically for iOS 27.

Apple confirmed yesterday at its "Surf and Shine" event that iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27 and watchOS 27 will officially launch next Monday, 9月14日 (September 14).

Apple announced today that developers can download the Xcode 27 Release Candidate starting today and submit apps and games for review using the latest SDK.

Apple also reminded developers that macOS 27 will only support software built natively for Apple silicon:

Additionally, Apple reminded developers that they need to fill out a new age rating questionnaire, as the questions apply to features like Screen Time. Apple also encouraged developers to prepare new title designs and search result assets for their App Store product pages, and provided updated design guidelines and templates to help them create product pages, screenshots, app previews and In-App Events.

Finally, Apple reiterated that "starting April 2027, all apps and games submitted to App Store Connect must meet the following minimum requirements":

  • iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with the iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 SDK or later
  • tvOS apps must be built with the tvOS 27 SDK or later
  • visionOS apps must be built with the visionOS 27 SDK or later
  • watchOS apps must be built with the watchOS 27 SDK or later
